title: UTF-8 is specified as a transformation format of ISO 10646
summary: UTF-8 is specified as a transformation format of ISO 10646.
body: RFC 3629 specifies UTF-8 as a transformation format of ISO 10646, the universal coded character set. The source says: "Yergeau Request for Comments: 3629 Alis Technologies STD: 63 November 2003 Obsoletes: 2279 Category: Standards Track UTF-8, a transformation format of ISO 10646 Status of this Memo This document specifies an Internet standards track protocol for the Internet community, and requests discussion and suggestions for improvements." UTF-8 is a way of representing those characters in bytes. It is not itself the list of characters. The character repertoire is the Unicode/ISO 10646 standard, which is a different document.
